verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an API-key-authenticated REST API (Bearer token) and an MCP server that 'drives the whole platform', so it can be controlled programmatically without the UI. A one-line scripted install and Docker options support unattended deployment. There is no documented CLI, no CI integration guidance, and no published OpenAPI spec (probe found none). Missing for 10: an official CLI for headless use, documented CI/CD pipeline usage (e.g. deploying or testing flows from CI), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.
you can pass the API key as a Bearer token in the header
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
One line writes the config, generates your secrets, and starts everything.
